spa_packs.config.title: SmoothPlayerAnimations Settings
spa_packs.config.enabled.tooltip:
Master switch. Off: the player is vanilla's again, model and animation, and this mod leaves it alone (the cape, elytra and armor are drawn as vanilla draws them too).
Switching it reloads the resources by itself (as F3+T does), so other mods' models (EMF, ...) follow.
spa_packs.config.cem.enabled.tooltip:
Off: the jointed model bends, playing this mod's animations (resource packs can replace them).
On: the vanilla model with straight limbs, made for the Fresh Animations (FA) resource pack: FA plays walking, running, jumping and the rest, and this mod adds hand actions and what FA has no animation for. Without FA the body moves as in vanilla. Other mods' animations (Better Combat, ...) still show.
Applies at once. With the CEM engine on or off, Entity Model Features leaves the player to this mod.
spa_packs.config.cape_physics.tooltip:
On: the cape is cloth (jointed model and CEM engine alike): it bends with the body, streams back as you run, swings as you turn and hangs down once you stop, never passing through the body (the far-kicked straight legs of a CEM pack such as Fresh Animations may pass through its hem).
Off: vanilla's stiff cape.
Whether it shows, its texture and where it sits over armor stay vanilla's. With WaveyCapes installed, WaveyCapes does the cape. Resource packs can change its size and feel in assets/spa_packs/spa/cape.json.
spa_packs.config.lantern_physics.tooltip:
On: a held lantern (any lantern, copper ones too) swings on its chain as you walk, stop, strafe and turn, and settles once you stand still.
Off: it hangs still.
On the jointed model it hangs from its ring straight down either way, whatever the arm does.
spa_packs.config.foot_ik.tooltip:
Jointed model only (CEM engine off). On: each foot stands on the block under it: across a stair or slab edge one leg reaches down and the other bends its knee, and walking up and down steps the feet land on them.
Off: the feet follow the animation only, as on flat ground.
spa_packs.config.hand_reach: Hands reach for what you use
spa_packs.config.hand_reach.tooltip:
Jointed model only (CEM engine off). On: opening a door, trapdoor or gate, pulling a lever, pressing a button or opening a chest, the hand goes out to the spot you touched, rests there a moment and comes back; the elbow bends, the forearm never twists.
Off: the arm plays the swing animation only.
spa_packs.config.items.description:
Give other mods' items one of this mod's animations. Each row is an item (or a whole mod) and the animation it plays; these come before the resource packs' item rules. Saved changes apply at once.
Hold the item in your main hand, then open the settings and press + : the row starts with that item.
spa_packs.config.items.held.none: Main hand: empty (type the item into a new row)
spa_packs.config.items.tooltip: Press + to add a row; it starts with the item in your main hand. One item can have several rows, one each for its swing, use and hold.
spa_packs.config.items.item.tooltip:
A new row starts with the id of the item in your main hand. Or write:
· an item id: wizards:arcane_staff
· a whole mod: wizards
· ids starting alike: wizards:staff_*
· ids ending alike: *_spear
When several rules fit an item, the most specific wins.
spa_packs.config.items.animation.tooltip:
Swing: attacking, digging, placing. Sword also makes the item a sword for the sword combo and guard.
Use: holding the use button.
Hold: while held.
Vanilla gives that action vanilla's arm pose.
Where this mod has no such animation: a swing plays Interact, a use vanilla's arm pose, and a hold nothing (the arm keeps the walk, the idle, ...).
spa_packs.cem.need_fa: This mod no longer provides vanilla base animations. Install %s for the best experience.
spa_packs.config.animations.description: Animation switches for the CEM engine off (the jointed model). A motion vanilla has too looks as in vanilla when off; one this mod adds is skipped.
spa_packs.config.animations.cem.descript: Animation switches for the CEM engine on. Then Fresh Animations plays walking, running, jumping and the rest; these are only what this mod adds.
